resources.string: Helps locate your pickup and show your position while the map is open. Tap to manage permission in phone settings.
Location updates stop when you leave the map or minimize the app. The trip timer notification is separate from location tracking.
Your phone’s Location setting is off. Turn it on in phone settings to use GPS, even if app permission is allowed.
Open your phone settings to manage this app’s permissions.
Save your booking and message preferences on this phone. Live booking and message alerts are not available yet. Manage trip timer notifications in phone settings.
Booking responses, arrival, and trip status updates.
